subject.title: Fix dashboard chat run recovery across reconnects

question: Should maintainers ask for a contributor rebase, adopt this branch into a current-main replacement, or pause it behind the newer Control UI recovery work?
rationale: The PR still targets a real linked bug, but current main has moved the protocol/UI/restart ownership surfaces and the branch is dirty, proof-gated, and not mechanically safe to repair without an owner decision.

options.title: Adopt into a current-main replacement
options.body: Preserve the useful attribution and rebuild the fix against packages/gateway-protocol and the current chat run lifecycle before requiring live proof.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase
options.body: Keep this branch as the landing candidate only if the contributor updates it to current main and addresses the review findings with real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause behind newer work
options.body: Leave this PR open but unmergeable until maintainers decide whether the newer Control UI recovery cluster supersedes this branch.

recommendation.title: Adopt into a current-main replacement
recommendation.body: Preserve the useful attribution and rebuild the fix against packages/gateway-protocol and the current chat run lifecycle before requiring live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev owns the closest merged Control UI reconnect mitigation and is best positioned to judge whether this branch should be rebased or replaced.
